newsitem.title: USA: CPI Aerostructures gets $2.7 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: CPI Aerostructures gets $2.7 mln in orders.

text.p: CPI Aerostructures Inc said on Tuesday it had received more than $2.7 million in new government orders for the federal fiscal year starting Oct 1.

The company said in a statement that revenues for the nine months ending Sept 30 were expected to exceed total revenues for last year, "which will make 1996 a significant improvement over 1995 in both revenue and profit.
"With our new government contracts and a pickup in our commercial business, 1997 should reflect a continuation of this growth pattern."
The company, a producer of structural aircraft parts and sub-assemblies, has hired Chase Manhattan Bank as its new senior lender. The bank will help CPI on acquisitions, the statement said.
